events.verdict: Jackson (SAC) moves alongside Kuzma (LAL) and absorbs contact as it is made after his gather.
Ingram (LAL) establishes his vertical position in Fox's (SAC) and absorbs the contact as Fox jumps into his body on his driving shot attempt.
Fox (SAC) briefly places his arm around Caldwell-Pope's (LAL) midsection before correcting.
LLB shows Caldwell-Pope (LAL) makes marginal contact with Bogdanovic's (SAC) front as he releases the shot attempt.
Kuzma (LAL) goes to, not through, Jackson's (SAC) space in the lane.
Kuzma (LAL) takes away Jackson's (SAC) landing area after the release of his jump shot attempt.
Hart (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position in Shumpert's (SAC) defensive path and absorbs contact as it is made.
Caldwell-Pope (LAL) moves laterally into Fox's (SAC) path and creates body contact that affects his SQBR.
Shumpert (SAC) and Ingram (LAL) engage and disengage off-ball without affecting the other's FOM.
Chandler (LAL) sets the pick on Fox (SAC), who is stationary, and delivers slight contact that does not affect his ability to defend.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) slightly turns his body but the contact is marginal to Kuzma's (LAL) body on his driving shot attempt.

Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes contact with Chandler's (LAL) face after dislodging him of the ball during the rebound. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Hart (LAL) maintains legal guarding position as contact is made with Bogdanovic (SAC) after his gather, then cleanly blocks his shot attempt.

After attempting to block the shot attempt, Chandler (LAL) makes incidental contact with Bogdanovic's (SAC) head/neck area. Chandler looks to avoid the contact, but Bogdanovic leans slightly back into his path. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Ingram (LAL) makes a brief marginal touch to Jackson's (SAC) body after he releases his shot attempt near the rim.
[Observable in enhanced video] Kuzma (LAL) lands consecutively on the same foot he gathered on.
Caldwell-Pope (LAL) makes incidental contact with Jackson (SAC) during the rebound.
Fox (SAC) commits the take foul on Ingram (LAL) along the baseline.
[Observable in enhanced video] Bogdanovic (SAC) enters the lane prior to the release of Ingram's (LAL) free throw attempt.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) sets the screen on Caldwell-Pope (LAL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
